description: What SkyUI 5.2 (SE) checks when the Inventory opens: SKI_Main CheckMenuVersion and CheckItemMenuComponents read UI.GetInt/GetString(menu, "_global.<Class>.SKYUI_RELEASE_IDX" / "SKYUI_VERSION_STRING") and show SKYUI ERROR CODE 5 when they are zero or empty. Applies only when the player has SkyUI 5.2: the menu works without them, SkyUI only shows the popup. Names and values only, no SkyUI code (S-B results and variant 7, TEST-IN-GAME-0.5.md).
